title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin trades at 62950 after a 1.7 percent slide, with fear entrenched at a 27 reading. Asia kept steady selling pressure overnight, capping any rebound attempts. Hashrate sits firm at 781 EH/s while the mempool swells to 98k transactions, fees pinned at just 2 sat per vbyte. Block 958393 confirmed. Watch 62k support closely—if it cracks, downside could accelerate into the US open.
